units.text: I ran the yearly budget round for 6 departments. I sent every manager a pre-filled Excel template with last year actuals and had review meetings, so all budgets were approved before the board deadline.
I was part of the month-end close and did some of the closing reports.
I wrote a Python script, it compares the bank transaction file with ledger postings every night and lists the differences. It replaced the manual bank reconciliation which took 6 hours every week.
I explained too much just face to face.
